The algebra yields positive exact threshold formulas and strict endpoint signs; q_s^s→e and c_s→1 give alternating stiff limits. value.rationale: For this recently established uniquely SSP-optimal implicit third-order family, determining the maximal spectral-step interval is a natural nontrivial numerical-analysis invariant for dissipative semidiscretizations.
